text:
elaine: RFC posted for PRD 'multi-tier routing + graceful fallback' — doc: https://redwood.app/PRD-420
Please review acceptance criteria, edge cases, and launch criteria by EOD Wed. Need sign-offs from eng, infra, srm, and legal.

samir: quick q — do we require identical outputs across hosted/dedicated? Acceptance criteria 2 is ambiguous.

elaine: good catch. AC2: functionally equivalent within 2% token-delta for standard prompts. I'll edit.

jonas: from infra: need explicit capacity fallback policy. What happens when kv-cache warms fail? Add an acceptance item for SLA fallback latency targets.

maya: eng note — we can't guarantee 2% delta for quantized variants. Can we scope to 'behaviorally consistent' and add tolerated quality regression threshold + rollback plan?

product-bot: Checklist added ->
```
- ACs listed
- Rollout plan (canary)
- Decision owner
- Hazops sign-off
- Metrics dashboard
```

samir: metrics we care about: p99 gen latency, tokens/sec, effective cost per token, model quality regression (prompt-set pass rate)

elaine: updated ACs and added rollback policy + measurement harness link: https://ci.redwood/tests/prd-420

jonas: infra ok on fallback policy if we add region routing and model-variant fallback. Need SLOs: p95 < 350ms, fallback p95 < 900ms.

maya: eng sign-off on scope if we remove strict 2% numeric AC and use 'no user-visible degradation' + regression alerting.

amanda: SRM sign-off pending customer commit. We have 2 customers asking for dedicated capacity SLA. Amanda, can you confirm stake?

amanda: Confirmed — two paying customers need dedicated cap by Q2. We'll escalate if rollout delayed.

jonas: note: on-prem path requires legal review for KMS. Tagging @legal

legal-bot: Legal review requested: export controls + KMS contract addendum. ETA 3 business days.

elaine: decision log: We'll proceed with canary in hosted, dedicated as opt-in; on-prem path requires legal hold. Owner: @elaine. Next steps: final signoffs by Fri.

maya: +1 from eng. I'll own rollout playbook.

samir: +1 metrics + eval harness ownership (I'll own)

jonas: +1 infra

amanda: +1 srm

elaine: All right — final signoffs logged. If no objections by EOD Fri, mark RFC approved and schedule kickoff. :white_check_mark:
